up: Find all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1125820'. For each such molecule, retrieve its ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES. Return each distinct molecule only once. If a molecule does not have a canonical SMILES entry, still include it and leave the SMILES column empty. The molecules are linked to the document through compound_records, so join molecule_dictionary with compound_records and then with docs on doc_id, and optionally join compound_structures to get SMILES.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1125820';
